name: claude-ecosystem-hygiene
description: Eight complementary skills for auditing, measuring, and maintaining Claude Code ecosystem health and project test quality. Audit → measure (Claude stack + project tests) → clean → stay consistent: identify HOT vs DORMANT artifacts, measure whether the HOT ones actually improve outcomes, measure whether your project's automated tests actually catch bugs, prune what doesn't pull its weight, and keep project docs in sync with the lessons that supersede them.

plugins.name: ecosystem-audit
plugins.description: Full-coverage Claude Code ecosystem audit: skills usage from JSONL session logs, memory hygiene, handoff lifecycle, ADR integrity, worktree lifecycle scoring, and automation health. Produces an interactive HTML report with radar chart.

plugins.name: ab-harness
plugins.description: Counterfactual A/B + layered-ablation harness for Claude Code setup. Measures whether your ~/.claude/ stack actually improves task outcomes. Heavyweight ($10–$80 per run, 30min–3hrs). Pairs with ecosystem-audit (identify HOT artifacts) and memory-hygiene (prune what the harness shows adds no value).

plugins.name: memory-hygiene
plugins.description: Audit and clean up Claude Code's persistent memory system — MEMORY.md, memory topic files, lessons, axioms, phase templates, ADRs, and the project docs/ taxonomy. v3.3 defines the canonical 7-bucket docs/ taxonomy session-handoff dispatches to and adds label-table integrity audit.

plugins.name: doc-freshness-reverse-lint
plugins.description: Detect stale normative guidance in project docs/ after a correction lands in lessons.md / axioms.md / feedback_*.md. Event-driven PostToolUse hook + weekly cron audit. Also audits ~/.claude/skills/ for expired last_verified frontmatter (axiom #21). Invoked by session-handoff Phase 4. Lists file:line candidate stale claims — never auto-edits.

plugins.name: test-effectiveness-auditor
plugins.description: Quantitatively measure how effective a project's automated test suite is at catching real bugs, by replaying historical incidents at pre-fix commits and classifying CI failure history. Sibling 'measure' tool to ab-harness — ab-harness measures whether your Claude Code stack improves outcomes, this measures whether your project's tests do. Bundled from wan-huiyan/test-effectiveness-auditor.

plugins.name: repo-hygiene
plugins.description: Pre-PR checklist and repo cleanup for data-science / analytics projects — catches data files committed to git, hardcoded /Users/ paths, tracked runtime artifacts, and client data in public repos. The project-quality track's 'clean' tool, sibling to test-effectiveness-auditor.

plugins.name: skill-portfolio-repo-placement-scan
plugins.description: Scan a portfolio of authored Claude Code skills and produce, per target repo, a precise list of which skills to ADD, which to UPDATE (with drift direction), and which to CROSS-LINK rather than copy. Per-repo function bars + portfolio dedup + version divergence check. Decides placement; run before skill-portfolio-audit (quality).

plugins.name: claude-plugin-repo-ci-release
plugins.description: Wire up CI validation + automatic release-cutting for a Claude Code plugin/marketplace repo: a structure validator on every PR/push and a release-on-version-bump job, plus the bundled validator script and workflow templates. Use when a plugin repo has no CI or its GitHub Releases drift behind the shipped version.
